definition: a drawing that explains how something works
description: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

taps.phrase: to stride into the lecture hall
